title: Bust Blasting
statementMd:
Charlie the CNC miller is a cad with a capital 'C'. He is going to clone a valuable statue of a famous voxel-based video game character, and you are going to help him.

The voxel shape is defined by three photos Charlie took, which have been traced into the form of simple, axis-aligned (but potentially concave) polygons representing front ($xy$), side ($zy$), and top ($xz$) views of the statue respectively.

The meaning of "axis-aligned" here is that every edge of every polygon is parallel with one of the $X$/$Y$/$Z$ axes.

Any 3-dimensional point not contained by all three polygon projections will be blasted out of existence leaving only the true form, which may consist of multiple pieces or no pieces at all.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ac018eb42c5be1fe6eac1c18b4f07e7c39ec2c02.png)Illustration of a complex statue.

Calculate the volume of the final statue.

## Input

The input consists of three lines of input, each giving one view as a two-dimensional, axis-aligned polygon in anti-clockwise order, with integer coordinates measured in centimetres.

- First, the number of points, $n_i$ ($4 \le n \le 100$).
- Thereafter, $n_i$ pairs of integers $u_{ij}$ and $v_{ij}$ for all $1 \le j \le n_i$ ($-10\,000 \le u,v \le 10\,000$).

It is guaranteed that for all adjacent vertices $a$ and $b$, $u_{ia} = u_{ib}$ or $v_{ia} = v_{ib}$. No three consecutive vertices are collinear.

## Output

Output the integer total volume of the resulting shape(s) in cubic centimetres.
statementZhMd:
数控铣工 Charlie 是个十足的无赖。他打算仿制一座珍贵的雕像，雕像的原型是某款著名体素电子游戏中的角色，而你将帮助他完成这件事。

这个体素形状由 Charlie 拍摄的三张照片确定。这些照片已被描摹成简单的轴对齐多边形（可能是凹多边形），分别表示雕像的正视图（$xy$）、侧视图（$zy$）和俯视图（$xz$）。

这里的“轴对齐”是指，每个多边形的每条边都平行于 $X$/$Y$/$Z$ 轴中的某一条。

对于任意一个三维点，只要它在三个投影平面上的投影未全部落在对应的多边形内，就会被爆破清除，最终只留下雕像的真实形状。剩余形状可能由多个部分组成，也可能什么都不剩。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ac018eb42c5be1fe6eac1c18b4f07e7c39ec2c02.png)一座复杂雕像的示意图。

计算最终雕像的体积。

## 输入格式

输入包含三行，每行以一个二维轴对齐多边形描述一个视图。多边形的顶点按逆时针顺序给出，坐标均为整数，单位为厘米。

- 首先给出顶点数 $n_i$（$4 \le n \le 100$）。
- 随后给出 $n_i$ 对整数 $u_{ij}$ 和 $v_{ij}$，其中 $1 \le j \le n_i$（$-10\,000 \le u,v \le 10\,000$）。

保证对于任意两个相邻顶点 $a$ 和 $b$，都有 $u_{ia} = u_{ib}$ 或 $v_{ia} = v_{ib}$。任意三个连续顶点均不共线。

## 输出格式

输出所得形状的总体积，为一个整数，单位为立方厘米。
